annotations.title: Get how much SOL is still locked in stake account lockups and how much unlocks soon.

description: Get how much SOL is still locked in stake account lockups and how much unlocks soon. Returns the locked SOL total (and the delegated part), the next unlock day, the SOL unlocking in the next 7, 30, 90 and 365 days, and the last unlock date. Use solana_unlocks_get_unlock_calendar for the schedule. Free, no payment needed. Source: Solana mainnet-beta (stake account lockups via JSON-RPC), Public on-chain data.
name: solana_unlocks_get_unlock_summary
